entities.summary: Antequera is a city and municipality in the Comarca de Antequera, province of Málaga, part of the Spanish autonomous community of Andalusia. It is known as "the heart of Andalusia" because of its central location among Málaga, Granada, Córdoba, and Seville. The Antequera Dolmens Site is a UNESCO World Heritage site. Antequera is a city in Southern Europe. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
